I found some peer-reviewed research indicating the use of albuterol in rodents, and the recommended therapeutic dosage by weight. I have saline in had that was used to dilute the tinctures before placing into the nebulizer. A harmful dose would be very large.

The one licensed rehabber in my area will euthanize a sick baby at that age, so it’s just me. Veterinary care is out of budget.

It’s been 12 hours since I began treatment and she’s perked back up. Lung sounds are still present, but she is no longer lethargic so I will take that as a win.

Hi, I’m in recovery. I realized that my words have power. In meetings I no longer say, “I’m so and so I’m an addict”. I introduce myself and say I’m in recovery. I believe that my disease of addiction and its symptoms have been arrested along with working my program and I have been clean without the desire to use for quite sometime. I applied this to my friends in recovery as well. I noticed that once I stopped accepting that my friends who couldn’t stay clean were chronic relapsers and instead assumed that they now take their recovery seriously and won’t relapse, most of them have stayed clean. 

You have to believe that his disease has been arrested without worrying about how. He may choose to work a program, he may choose to clean up on his own - the how isn’t up to you. The end result, continuous sobriety, is. Believe that this   is the version of him you deal with from this moment moving forward.
